description: Contaminant dynamics in offchannel embayments of Port Jackson, New South Wales is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Iron Cove, Hen and Chicken Bay, Homebush Bay, and Rozelle/Blackwattle Bay are offchannel embayments on the southern shoreline of Port Jackson. These shallow ( 90% mud), termed the hydrous layer. Sediment in these offchannel embayments is highly enriched in metallic and organic contaminants and each embayment is characterised by a distinct ratio of heavy-metal concentrations. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Journal, NSW, Published_External. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
